metadata.title: MediaClaw Welfare Center - Claim Trial and Usage Rewards
metadata.description: Use the MediaClaw welfare center to claim channel survey and extension feedback rewards.
metadata.keywords: MediaClaw welfare center, trial activation code, activation code, channel survey, experience feedback

hero.title: Claim MediaClaw welfare rewards
hero.description: Complete the channel survey to claim a reward. After real extension usage, submit feedback in the extension for an extra reward.

partner_promo.title: Invite friends, earn commission
partner_promo.banner_title: Partner Program · You earn commission, friends get a discount

items.title: Channel Survey Reward
items.description: Answer a few questions after signing in, then claim a trial code or confirm which activation code to extend.

items.title: Experience Feedback Reward
items.description: After trying scraping, export or sync, or monitoring features, submit feedback in the extension for an extra reward.

success_modal.title: Reward Claimed
success_modal.subtitle: Enter the activation code in extension preferences to verify and bind it

guide.title: Activation Setup Guide
steps: Open the MediaClaw extension and enter Preferences from the top-right menu.
Paste the activation code into Product Authorization Status.
Click Verify and Bind to finish setup.
guide.image_alt: MediaClaw activation code and preferences guide

channel_survey.title: Channel Survey Reward
channel_survey.description: Submit to claim the reward: accounts without activation codes get a trial code directly; accounts with activation codes must confirm which code to extend.
channel_survey.sign_in_required: Please sign in or create an account first. You will return to the welfare center after signing in.
channel_survey.unavailable: The welfare center table is not initialized yet. Run the website database migration first.

fields.source: Where did you hear about MediaClaw?
fields.use_case: What do you want to use MediaClaw for first?

placeholders.source_question: e.g. how to bulk export Xiaohongshu comments
placeholders.role_other: e.g. content consultant, ecommerce ops, course creator

use_case_options.label: Find topics / decide content direction
capabilities: Keyword search scraping for low-follower viral posts

use_case_options.label: Analyze benchmark accounts
capabilities: Bulk collect creator profile post data and content
Benchmark account monitoring and Feishu daily reports

use_case_options.label: Research influencers / seeding / campaigns
capabilities: Evaluate creator performance and comment sentiment

use_case_options.label: Private traffic leads / lead mining
capabilities: Export leads to Excel / sync to Feishu

channel_survey.use_case_hint: Multiple choices allowed. Choices record your intent; hover the question mark to see the plugin capabilities involved.
channel_survey.auto_reward_note: After submission, MediaClaw checks your account: if you have no activation code, a trial code is generated directly; if you have activation codes, you confirm which one to extend.

reward_credential.title: Choose an activation code to extend
reward_credential.description: Your account already has activation codes. Please confirm which one should receive this welfare reward.

channel_survey.footnote: Each account can claim the channel survey reward once; trial access is also limited to one claim per browser installation.
channel_survey.trial_done: A trial activation code has been generated. Copy it and enter it in the extension settings page.
channel_survey.paid_extension_done: The selected activation code has received the welfare reward. Check the latest expiry date and credits on the activation code page.

errors.required: Please complete the required choices and any expanded fields first
errors.reward_credential_required: Please choose an activation code to extend.
errors.reward_credential_not_found: Could not find an extendable activation code. Please refresh and try again.
errors.browser_claimed: This browser has already claimed a trial. Please use the existing activation code or choose a paid plan.
errors.submit_failed: Submit failed. Please try again later

experience_feedback.title: Experience Feedback Reward
experience_feedback.description: Experience feedback is submitted in the extension; the website keeps the entry and final status.
experience_feedback.sign_in_required: Please sign in or create an account first. You will return to the welfare center after signing in.
experience_feedback.unavailable: The welfare center table is not initialized yet. Run the website database migration first.
experience_feedback.plugin_completed: Claimed {days} membership days in the extension
experience_feedback.plugin_completed_description: This reward was verified and issued in the extension. The website only syncs the final claimed state.
experience_feedback.plugin_ready_description: Return to the MediaClaw extension welfare center to submit real feedback. The extension will verify the activation code and issue the reward.
experience_feedback.plugin_required_title: Complete real usage in the extension
experience_feedback.plugin_required_description: Experience feedback must be based on real usage: finish scraping, export or sync, and try high-value keyword, public-opinion, or monitoring features before submitting inside the extension. Real-time progress is shown in the extension.

progress.output_description: Successful data export, copy, or sync actions

experience_feedback.failure_blocked: There have been several recent failures. Complete one successful action before claiming in the extension.

placeholders.comment: What felt smooth, what blocked you, and whether the experience matched your expectation
placeholders.expected_feature: Which scraping, analysis, sync, or automation features should we prioritize?

experience_feedback.trial_done: A trial activation code has been generated. Copy it and enter it in the extension settings page.
experience_feedback.paid_extension_done: The selected activation code has received the welfare reward. Check the latest expiry date and credits on the activation code page.
